ai_summary_zh: 該場區為乾燥的都市/校園/公園區域，主要特徵是廣泛的柏油混凝土鋪面道路和人行道，總面積約942.5平方公尺。現場有35棵都市樹木，平均胸徑為28.5公分，以及40面擋土/建築牆，垂直面積達723.7平方公尺。值得注意的是，場區內未發現任何水體或河流空隙。
ai_summary_en: The site is a dry urban/campus/park area characterized by extensive paved asphalt concrete roads and walkways, totaling approximately 942.5 m2. It features 35 urban trees with an average DBH of 28.5 cm and 40 retaining/building walls covering 723.7 m2 of vertical area. Importantly, no water bodies or river voids were identified on site.
